title: Ultimate Custom Run
description: Customize custom runs with collapsible modifier groups, linked exclusive choices and native value sliders. Specialized, All Star and Friendship: 1-10 cards/copies, step 1; Draft and Sealed Deck: 5-20 cards, step 5; Insanity: 5-60 cards, step 5; Hoarder: 1-5 additional copies, step 1; Midas: 150-300% of normal gold rewards, step 5%. Values persist in saves and sync from the co-op host. Includes Neow!!, Specialized - Draft, Specialized - Pick Any, All Star - Draft, Friendship and Friendship - Draft, Colorless Cards, Rich Loot (treasure chests contain 1 extra relic to choose from) and Card Swarm (extra card in card rewards). Custom-only modifiers do not enter the Daily Challenge pool; vanilla Daily values are preserved. No BaseLib dependency. Built against Slay the Spire 2 v0.111.0. Gameplay mod: every co-op player needs it. Pre-release build.
changeNote: Version 1.7.0: new UltimateCustomRun Workshop item. Added native value sliders with save and co-op synchronization. Hoarder supports 1-5 additional copies. Clarified Rich Loot: treasure chests contain 1 extra relic to choose from.
